resources.string: Connect to the same Wi-Fi recommended
Pick a file then start sending, wait for receiver.
Tap scan, then tap a device in the list to receive.
Scanning, found devices will show in the list
· Discovery: UDP broadcast, LANFILE|IP:port|name\n· Transfer: direct TCP, no server\n· Both devices on same Wi-Fi
· Network: LAN communication\n· Storage: read file to send, save received file to Download
Tap “About” above for version, open source and license.
Native TCP + UDP broadcast LAN file transfer. No server, no cloud.
